steps.content: [Tuco - Square]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huff, huff... We won...
Thanks to the hard work of Hella and the townsfolk, the monsters that came with the sandstorm all got driven away.
The wind weakens, and the tide of monsters starts to retreat. Hella sighs in relief, failing to notice a straggler lunging from behind.

steps.speaker: Sand Beast
steps.content: Roarrrr—!
(Transition, gunshot)
The sand beast's body topples to the ground. Hella, still shaken, looks back to see the bounty hunter's smoking gun.
Korryn spins the gun handle flamboyantly and blows a kiss to the young girl. Hella can't hear her words, but reads her lips...
"See, I stuck around to fight with you this time, didn't I?"
...Hmph. That silver-tongued devil.
The next moment, Hella suddenly feels weightless, and her view rises. Someone has lifted her up, and she's surrounded by cheers.
Cheering in celebration of their victory against the sandstorm, the townspeople of Tuco surround Hella and hold her up, ready to have a feast.
At the edge of the crowd, Wright huffs as he drags over the box from the little depot. He opens the box, and blue Hypercube light quickly spreads to dispel the remaining contamination in the town.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hey, big hero, why the long face? We just won a hard battle. Why not crack a smile?
A pair of hands rescues Hella from the crowd's embrace; it's Korryn.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Don't you realize that I just saw all the Hypercubes you guys stashed away?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hmm?
She takes a moment to process the words, then pats Hella on the head with a smile.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No worries. We've been in the same boat for quite a while now.
The crowd is already cheering and celebrating. Mira collects the remaining Hypercubes and takes the box back to the motel, storing it in a hidden compartment behind the counter.
They did everything out in the open, making no effort to hide it from Hella. The people of Tuco already see her as one of their own.
Korryn ruffles Hella's hair once more.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Let's go to the celebration banquet! They're gonna show off their cooking skills today. If we don't hurry, we won't get any food!
Hella doesn't respond, but just silently follows along towards Tuco Motel.
